introHtml: When you need a practical giveaway that teams can actually use, custom set pocket utility knives deliver. A set typically includes multiple knives or a knife with extra blades, making them ideal for safety managers stocking toolkits or brands sending contractor gifts. Choose debossed logos or full-color imprinting on the handles for a clean, professional look that stands up to daily use.
